Cedar Prairie School District No. 427  |  RFP No. 27-02  |  District-Wide Custodial ServicesSection 1 – General Information

Section 1 – General Information

1.1 Purpose. The Board of Directors of Cedar Prairie School District No. 427 (the “District”) requests proposals from qualified firms to provide district-wide production custodial services, including all labor, supervision, training, equipment, cleaning chemicals and floor finishes, at the school sites and support facilities listed in Exhibit A, Schedule of Facilities. The District will furnish paper products, hand soap and trash liners. One (1) contract will be awarded to the responsive, responsible proposer whose proposal is most advantageous to the District.

1.2 Term of Contract. The initial term of the contract shall be one (1) year, from July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2028. Upon mutual written agreement the contract may be renewed for up to four (4) additional one-year periods, for a maximum term of five (5) years (through June 30, 2032). Renewal pricing adjustments are limited to the change in the Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue CPI-U for the preceding calendar year, not to exceed four percent (4%).

1.3 Current Contract. Custodial services are presently provided by Sound & Summit Building Care, LLC under Contract No. CPSD-C-22-031, awarded by the Board in May 2022 for a one-year initial term with four one-year renewals; the final renewal year ends June 30, 2027. Payments under the contract for the 2025-26 school year (July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026), including summer deep cleaning, totaled $3,412,860. Total payments from July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2026 (48 months) were $12,904,115. This information is provided for reference only and is not a guarantee of the value of the new contract.

1.4 District Profile. The District serves approximately 11,200 students in eleven elementary schools, three middle schools, two comprehensive high schools and one alternative learning center, and maintains approximately 1.51 million square feet of permanent building space plus 44 portable classrooms. The District calendar provides 180 student attendance days and four (4) non-student work days on which custodial service is required.

1.5 Pre-Proposal Meeting and Walk-Through. A pre-proposal meeting will be held at the date and time on the cover page in the Board Room of the Administrative Service Center, followed by walk-throughs of Cedar Prairie High School, Hawthorne Middle School and Eagle Ridge Elementary School. Proposers may schedule visits to other locations through the Purchasing Office. Floor plans with room-by-room areas are available on request.

1.6 Questions and Addenda. Questions must be submitted in writing by the deadline on the cover page. Answers, and any changes to the RFP, will be issued only by written addendum posted on the District's purchasing web page. Oral statements by District staff are not binding.

1.7 Insurance, Bonding and Liquidated Damages. The Contractor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 aggregate, automobile liability of $1,000,000, and employee dishonesty / third-party crime coverage of $250,000. A performance bond equal to 100% of the first-year contract price is required within ten (10) days of award. Liquidated damages of $350 per occurrence may be assessed for each building not cleaned on a scheduled cleaning day.

1.8 Background Checks. All Contractor employees with access to District buildings shall complete fingerprint-based criminal history record checks through the Washington State Patrol and FBI in accordance with RCW 28A.400.303 before beginning work, and shall wear District-issued identification badges at all times.

1.9 Basis of Award. Proposals will be evaluated on: experience with K-12 facilities of comparable size (25 points); staffing plan, supervision and quality control (30 points); transition plan (10 points); and price (35 points). The District may award to other than the lowest priced proposal.

Section 2 – Scope of Work

2.1 General. The Contractor shall provide all routine (“production”) custodial cleaning in all areas of each building listed in Exhibit A, including classrooms, portable classrooms, offices, libraries, gymnasiums, locker rooms, cafeterias and commons, corridors, stairwells, elevators, restrooms and entrances, to a level equal to APPA Level 2 (“Ordinary Tidiness”). Restrooms, nurse’s rooms and cafeteria dining areas shall be maintained to APPA Level 1.

2.2 Facilities. The locations to be cleaned, the area of each, enrollment and the cleaning schedule are shown in Exhibit A, Schedule of Facilities. Custodial services shall be provided at all portable classroom units at each location. The number of portables at a location may change during the term as units are added, relocated or surplused; the contract will be adjusted under Section 2.7.

2.3 Square Footage and Portable Classrooms. Column (9) of Exhibit A, “Permanent Building SF,” is the gross area of the permanent school building(s) at each location as recorded in the District’s ICOS facility inventory. Column (9) does not include portable classrooms. Portable classrooms are listed separately in Column (10) as the number of units “@” the area of each unit (e.g., “4 @ 960” means four portables of 960 SF each; “dbl.” denotes a double-classroom unit). For this contract the area of each school is the Permanent Building SF plus the area of all portables at that school. This combined figure is the “Pricing Area” shown in Exhibit B and is the basis for the monthly price and for any adjustment. Covered play shelters, covered walkways and open courtyards are not included in any area.

2.4 School-Year Cleaning Schedule. Schools (Exhibit A Column (12) “M–F”) shall be cleaned every weekday on which students or staff are scheduled to be in the building under the District calendar – 180 student days plus four non-student work days, approximately 184 days per year. Cleaning shall begin no earlier than 3:30 p.m. (elementary) or 3:00 p.m. (secondary) and be complete by 11:30 p.m. No routine service is required on weekends, District holidays, winter break or spring break, except as ordered under Section 2.9. The Administrative Service Center is cleaned Monday through Friday year-round (approximately 250 days). The Transportation and Maintenance Facility is cleaned Monday, Wednesday and Friday year-round.

2.5 Summer Deep Cleaning. Between the last student day in June and August 20 of each year, the Contractor shall perform a complete deep clean of every school, including: strip and refinish all resilient (VCT and sheet vinyl) floors; hot-water extract all carpet; machine scrub and seal ceramic tile and grout; clean all walls, windows (interior), light fixtures, vents and furniture; and clean and sanitize all portable classrooms. Daily cleaning of occupied areas continues Monday through Thursday at summer school sites (Glacier View Elementary and Cedar Prairie High School, July 6 – July 30). Schools not hosting summer school receive no daily service during July and August.

2.6 Gymnasium Wood Floors. Column (11) of Exhibit A lists the area of maple wood athletic floor in each main gymnasium and, where shown, auxiliary gymnasium. The wood floor area is part of the permanent building and is included in Column (9). The Contractor shall dust-mop wood floors daily and screen and apply one (1) coat of District-approved finish to all listed wood floors during the summer deep-clean period. Sanding, game-line painting and full refinishing are performed by a separate District contractor. A dash (“—”) indicates a multipurpose room with VCT or sport-tile flooring and no wood floor.

Cedar Prairie School District No. 427  |  RFP No. 27-02  |  District-Wide Custodial ServicesSection 2 – Scope of Work

2.7 Additions and Deletions to Building Locations and Square Footage. Additions and deletions to square footage may be applicable due to renovations, the addition or removal of portable classrooms, or the creation or closure of a school. Changes will be priced using the unit prices in Exhibit B, Part 3, prorated to the day. Location 208, Old Mill Elementary School, is under review for consolidation at the end of the 2026-27 school year (Exhibit A, Note 7); the District will confirm its status by addendum before proposals are due.

2.8 Areas and Services Not Included. The following are not part of this RFP: (a) school kitchens, serveries and food storage rooms, which are cleaned by Nutrition Services staff (cafeteria and commons dining areas are included; no deduction is made from Column (9) or the Pricing Area); (b) grounds maintenance, snow and ice removal, and exterior hardscape, which are performed by District Maintenance and Operations staff – site acreage in Exhibit A Column (7) is for information only; (c) the bus maintenance bays, parts room, wash bay and shops at the Transportation and Maintenance Facility (Exhibit A, Note 6); (d) restroom and concession buildings at Cedar Prairie Memorial Stadium and the District Aquatic Center, which are cleaned by event and pool staff; and (e) mechanical, electrical and custodial closets, except for trash removal.

2.9 Special Events and Extra Work. The District may order cleaning for evening and weekend community use, athletic events, elections and emergencies. Extra work will be ordered in writing and paid at the hourly rates in Exhibit B, Part 3. Approximately 1,900 hours of extra work were ordered in 2025-26.

2.10 Staffing, Supervision and Quality Control. The proposal shall include a staffing plan by location showing the number of custodians, the hours per shift, and supervision, together with the productivity rate (SF per hour) used for each building type. A working lead custodian shall be assigned to each secondary school, and an area supervisor shall cover no more than five (5) elementary schools. The District will conduct monthly joint inspections using the APPA appearance levels and a building condition score; scores below 80% require a written corrective action plan within five (5) days.

2.11 Equipment and Supplies. The Contractor shall furnish all cleaning equipment (auto-scrubbers, burnishers, extractors, backpack vacuums, floor machines), chemicals and finishes. Chemicals shall be Green Seal or EPA Safer Choice certified where available. The District will provide storage rooms and access to water and power at each location.

2.12 Transition. The Contractor shall offer employment to qualified custodial employees of the current contractor and shall submit a transition plan covering hiring, background checks, training and keys, to be completed by June 25, 2027.

ADDENDUM NO. 1
RFP No. 27-02 – District-Wide Custodial Services

Date of Addendum: November 16, 2026Proposal due date: unchanged – December 3, 2026, 2:00 p.m.

This Addendum is issued to modify, clarify and answer questions on the above RFP. It forms part of the RFP and controls over the original documents where they conflict. Proposers shall acknowledge receipt of this Addendum on the signature page of the proposal.

Item 1 – Deletion of Location 208, Old Mill Elementary School

On November 9, 2026 the Board of Directors adopted Resolution No. 2026-41 consolidating Old Mill Elementary School into Riverbend Elementary School effective at the end of the 2026-27 school year. Location 208, Old Mill Elementary School, is deleted from Exhibit A and from Exhibit B, Part 1, Line 8, in its entirety. The building will be placed in warm-closure status and maintained by District staff; it shall not be priced. Exhibit A, Note 7 is deleted.

Item 2 – Location 209, Riverbend Elementary School (portables)

Four (4) portable classrooms will be relocated from Old Mill Elementary School to Riverbend Elementary School during summer 2027. Exhibit A, Column (10) for Location 209 is revised from “2 @ 960” to “6 @ 960”. Column (9), Permanent Building SF, is unchanged at 52,064. Exhibit B, Part 1, Line 9: number of portables is revised from 2 to 6 and the Pricing Area is revised from 53,984 SF to 57,824 SF.

Item 3 – Location 901, Administrative Service Center (District Office)

The area in Exhibit A omitted the Board Room and Professional Development Annex (4,720 SF), which is connected to the main building by a covered breezeway and is cleaned with it (Note 8). Exhibit A, Column (9) for Location 901 is revised from 18,240 SF to 22,960 SF. Exhibit B, Part 2, Line 18: Pricing Area is revised from 18,240 SF to 22,960 SF.

Item 4 – Revised Totals

As a result of Items 1 through 3, the “TOTAL PRICING AREA – PARTS 1 AND 2” in Exhibit B is revised from 1,535,099 SF to 1,499,949 SF, and the number of school locations is revised from 17 to 16. The total in Exhibit A, Column (9) is revised from 1,513,705 SF to 1,478,555 SF.

Item 5 – Pre-Proposal Meeting Attendance

Eleven (11) firms attended the pre-proposal meeting on November 10, 2026. The sign-in sheet is posted with this Addendum. Attendance is not a condition of award.

Item 6 – Questions and Answers

Q1. Does the square footage in Exhibit A, Column (9) include the portable classrooms?
A1. No. As stated in Section 2.3 and Note 2, Column (9) excludes portables. The area of each school for this contract is Column (9) plus the area of all portables at that school, which is the Pricing Area in Exhibit B (as revised by this Addendum). For example, Alder Creek Elementary School is 51,340 SF plus 4 portables @ 960 SF = 55,180 SF.

Q2. Is the gymnasium wood floor area in Column (11) in addition to the building square footage?
A2. No. The wood floor area is part of the permanent building and is included in Column (9). It is listed only to scope the annual screen-and-recoat (Section 2.6).

Q3. Are the bus maintenance bays at the Transportation and Maintenance Facility to be cleaned?
A3. No. See Exhibit A, Note 6. Custodial service is limited to approximately 6,850 SF of the 28,400 SF building, three days per week.

Q4. What is the current annual cost of custodial services, and who is the incumbent?
A4. See Section 1.3. Sound & Summit Building Care, LLC (Contract No. CPSD-C-22-031) was paid $3,412,860 for 2025-26. The District does not publish the incumbent’s staffing levels.

Q5. Are the portable classrooms at Old Mill Elementary to be priced at Riverbend from July 1, 2027?
A5. Yes. Price Riverbend Elementary with six (6) portables for the full initial term (Item 2). The relocated units will be in place before August 20, 2027.

Q6. Will kitchens be deducted from the Pricing Area?
A6. No. Kitchens are cleaned by Nutrition Services staff (Section 2.8(a)) and represent a small share of each building; no deduction is made.

Q7. How many days per year are schools cleaned?
A7. Approximately 184 weekdays during the school year (Section 2.4), plus summer deep cleaning, plus daily service Monday through Thursday at the two summer school sites from July 6 to July 30.

Q8. Does the stadium at Cedar Prairie High School need to be cleaned?
A8. No. Stadium restroom and concession buildings are excluded (Section 2.8(d)).
